about_the_game:
Experience the full game-automation toolkit: a precise autoclicker, a reliable macro recorder, flexible macro binds, and full Steam Workshop support for sharing and downloading everything the community creates.

Classic Auto Clicker

A dependable, easy-to-use autoclicker that gives you complete control, with a lot more settings compared to any other autoclicker. Pick any key, set any interval, and automate with perfect consistency.

Macro Recorder

Capture your mouse and keyboard actions with millisecond accuracy. Whether you're grinding, or speeding through routine steps, you can record complex sequences and replay them exactly as they happened.

Steam Workshop

Browse a growing library of macros for all kinds of games, ready to download and use instantly. Beyond macros, explore and download custom visual themes to personalize the app’s look to your style.

Macro Binds

Turn your recorded actions into a toggleable playback bind. Assign a hotkey, tap it once to start the sequence, and tap again to stop—perfect for automation.

Theme Presets

Customize the entire look of the app. Choose from curated themes or upload your own wallpaper to give the interface a style that fits your setup.

short_description: My Auto Clicker is the ultimate autoclicker and game automation tool, combining a precise autoclicker, a reliable macro recorder, customizable playback binds, and the ability to browse and download community macros and themes published on the Steam Workshop—all in one clean package.
